title: Personnel of Willis Young's Minneapolis dance band
summary: Phillips lists three saxes including Lester and Clyde Turrentine, banjo, drums, Pete Jones, Mr. Young on tuba, pianist Curtis Oliver and two trumpets; 10-11 pieces.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What was the instrumentation at this time in the dance band. You mentioned a little bit about it before.
We had three saxophones.
Three saxophones. Do you remember the names?
Yeah. I said Lester...
Lester Young...
Clyde Turrentine. I think he got a son who plays sax out here now, a real bad saxophone player.
You mean Stanley?
Yeah. I'm not sure that's his son, but somebody said... I haven't seen him for a long time. I'm not sure that's his son...
Phillips - 73
I can talk to Tommy, his brother, who plays trumpet, who lives in my area. Now, you're not sure that he's...
I'm not sure that he's the father. Somebody told me, because it's been years and years since I...
The Turrentine brothers are from up around Pittsburgh, I think.
Yeah.
Anyway, Clyde Turrentine was playing what?
Playing tenor.
And who else was a saxophone player?
Ben Wilkerson.
So that's three saxophones.
He was using three saxophones. We didn't have no guitar; we had a banjo in the band.
Who was playing banjo?
I can't remember this cat's name. It was a new guy in the band. I'm not sure, but I think his name was Ray Jones.
Ray Jones was playing banjo.
He was playing banjo.
So that's three saxophones and a banjo.
Another Ben was playing drums -- his name was Ben Wilkerson. Both of them had the same name, but there was no relation. Pete Jones playing trombone. Then Mr. Young was playing tuba.
Phillips - 74
Willis Young was playing tuba.
Billy Young. That's what everybody know him by all over, was Billy.
But you called him Mr. Young.
Yeah, I called him Mr. Young because I always respected him like a father.
Who else was in the band? Irma and...
No, they weren't in the band.
So they were back with...
No, they was there, in Minneapolis. They all were up there.
But were they in the dance band?
No, they couldn't do that. Lee was too little. Lee wasn't but 10 or 12 years old. Those guys were playing; that was the first band. Then we had...
Anybody else besides those people you mentioned? Did you have a piano player?
Yeah. Curtis Oliver. That was it.
So you had piano, banjo tuba (Mr. Young), three saxophones...
Now, wait a minute.
You were on trumpet...
Arthur Williams, too. I forgot about him.
What did he play?
Trumpet.
Phillips - 75
Arthur Williams and "Phil" Phillips on trumpet, and Pete Jones on trombone.
Yeah. That was a real big band in those days -- 10-11 pieces.
